Module com.example.cab302project
Package com.example.cab302project.model

Class Activity

java.lang.Object
com.example.cab302project.model.Activity
public class Activity extends Object
Represents an activity belonging to a user.

An activity is complete when its progress reaches or exceeds its completion threshold. It can optionally belong to a goal or habit.

  • Constructor Details

    • Activity

      public Activity(Integer goalId, Integer habitId, Integer userId, String title, Category category, TaskType activityType, LocalDateTime startDateTime, LocalDateTime dueDateTime, Integer progress, Integer completionThreshold, Integer baseXpReward, Integer awardedXpReward, boolean doesContributeDirectlyToGoal)
      Creates an activity with its supplied state.

      A completion time is not inferred from existing progress. Historical activities may have an unknown completion time.

      Parameters:
      goalId - the associated goal ID, if present
      habitId - the associated habit ID, if present
      userId - the owning user's ID
      title - the activity title
      category - the wellbeing category
      activityType - the activity's task type
      startDateTime - the activity start time
      dueDateTime - the due time, or null when there is no deadline
      progress - the current progress
      completionThreshold - the progress required for completion
      baseXpReward - the potential XP reward
      awardedXpReward - the XP already awarded
      doesContributeDirectlyToGoal - whether progress contributes to a goal
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the title, threshold or dates are invalid

    • setProgress

      public void setProgress(Integer progress, LocalDateTime updatedAt)
      Updates progress and records the first transition to completion.

      An existing completion time is preserved. Updating an activity that was already complete with an unknown completion time does not invent a historical timestamp.

      Parameters:
      progress - the new progress value
      updatedAt - the time of the progress update

      public void setCompletedAt(LocalDateTime completedAt)
      Restores the completion time read from persistent storage.

      Normal progress updates should use setProgress(Integer) or setProgress(Integer, LocalDateTime).
